title: Make standard s-ci-runs-tests pass
body: Outcome: `krn standards check` no longer fails s-ci-runs-tests.

Why: adoption found this reflex standard failing: exit 1 from ci=$(cat .github/workflows/*.yml .github/workflows/*.yaml .gitlab-ci.yml 2>/dev/null); printf '%s\n' "$ci" | grep -qE 'pull_request|merge_request' &...
Proof: `krn standards check` passes the record.
